name: What are the advantages of carpet over other flooring types?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of carpet over other flooring types?

acceptedAnswer.text: Carpet offers several benefits, including improved sound absorption, making rooms quieter. It provides a softer surface, which can enhance comfort underfoot and reduce impact from falls. Carpet also acts as an insulator, potentially helping with energy efficiency by retaining warmth. With a wide range of colors, patterns, and textures, carpet allows for significant design flexibility to match various interior styles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Carpet provides sound absorption, comfort, insulation, and a wide variety of design options compared to other flooring.
